name: The Club at Frisco Farms
_comment_tees: Scorecard from GolfPass (2934, The Club at Frisco Farms, formerly Plantation Golf Club, as OpenStreetMap still names it); its pars match OpenStreetMap's hole tags (par 72); its handicaps differ from OSM's and are used. Ratings matched to tees by total yards (its tee table calls the 6375-yard tee Blue and the 5876 White); Red's is the women's (for 4904 yards).
_comment_drop: Polygons containing these points are not part of the course.
_comment_shift: OSM outlines sit this many metres off the Esri imagery; every point is moved by it (fitted to the greens: the sand is tan, so the bunker fit fails; the bunkers then sit on their sand).
